children: Envista published its 2025 Sustainability Report, highlighting progress on environmental efficiency, access to dental care, employee safety and governance.
The report outlines Envista’s progress on sustainability topics and provides a foundation for identifying opportunities for continued improvement.
Envista reported a 40% year-over-year reduction in waste generation and a 19% reduction in water consumption.
The Envista Smile Project donated $2.4 million, benefiting close to 20,000 patients through services, products and charitable support.
Envista’s lost time injury rate decreased 17% year over year.
